supporting_observations.claim: The repeated alerted connections were associated with stockpilotupd.exe running from Eli Brooks's user AppData directory, not the inventory-listed approved installation path under Program Files.
The updater process connected through the proxy to update.stockpilot.co, whereas the inventory identifies update.stockpilot.com as the approved StockPilot update host.
The connections to the lookalike update hostname recur at roughly five-minute intervals, including 13:41, 13:46, 13:51, 13:56, 14:00, 14:06, and 14:11 UTC; the 13:51 proxy attempt returned 504.
The updater process was observed creating a file at its own AppData executable path shortly after it started; the evidence does not establish what was written.

The non-inventory path and hostname mismatch, combined with the repeated updater-attributed connections, support treating the alerted activity as malicious rather than as the approved StockPilot check.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels, so the available records do not reveal the encrypted request or response contents.
The provided records do not include the updater's file hash, signature status, or file contents.
The records show the proxy CONNECT hostname and the process's connection to the proxy, but do not provide independent evidence about the external domain's ownership or reputation.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish what data, if any, was sent to or received from the external host.
The evidence does not establish whether the file creation event modified the updater or what the resulting file contained.
The evidence does not establish who installed or launched this AppData copy, or whether it successfully executed any downloaded content.
The evidence does not establish the external host's ownership or prove that the observed hostname is controlled by an attacker.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect the updater executable and any related files; determine their hashes, signature status, provenance, and contents.
Review endpoint file and download history around the executable's creation, including any child processes and persistence changes.
Obtain DNS, proxy, and network reputation or ownership data for update.stockpilot.co and preserve relevant proxy tunnel metadata.
Confirm with the software owner whether update.stockpilot.co and this AppData installation are authorized.
unrelated_findings: A Dropbox updater service process ran on WS-EBROOKS-01; Dropbox is not listed among approved services. Handle separately and do not use this alone to decide the alert. (T205-00091, T205-00092)

Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI launched on WS-EBROOKS-01 despite the inventory stating there is no VPN; handle separately and do not use this alone to decide the alert. (T205-00177, T205-00178, T205-00179)

A request to images.wellbridge.co was made through the proxy; the provided inventory does not identify this service as approved. Handle separately and do not use this alone to decide the alert. (T205-00299, T205-00300)
